mcpTools.name: list_layers
mcpTools.description: List all available layer types for shots

mcpTools.name: get_shot_layers
mcpTools.description: Get layer data for a specific shot with resolved data

mcpTools.name: list_genres
mcpTools.description: List all available genres for projects

mcpTools.name: list_projects
mcpTools.description: List the caller's movie projects (id, title, short name, type). Use this to find a project to work in.

mcpTools.name: list_characters
mcpTools.description: List the characters (cast) in a project — id, name, character, digital actor.

mcpTools.name: get_shot_cast
mcpTools.description: Get the cast of a specific shot — which characters are in it and whether they speak.

mcpTools.name: list_scenes
mcpTools.description: List the scenes of a project (id, number, title, place). Walk a movie: project → scenes → shots.

mcpTools.name: list_shots
mcpTools.description: List the shots of a scene (id, number, title, shot type, script).

mcpTools.name: get_shot
mcpTools.description: Get one shot in full — title, type, video, cast, and its first-frame image URL.

mcpTools.name: get_first_frame
mcpTools.description: Get a shot's first-frame image URL (the still that anchors the shot's look).

mcpTools.name: regenerate_first_frame
mcpTools.description: Generate or regenerate a shot's first-frame image from a prompt (the editor's AI chat window flow). SPENDS CREDITS and runs asynchronously — returns a jobId; poll get_job_status then get_first_frame. Regenerate = call again with an edited prompt (adds a new version).

mcpTools.name: get_job_status
mcpTools.description: Check an async generation job by id (PENDING/STARTED/PROGRESS/COMPLETED/ERROR).

mcpTools.name: update_character_action
mcpTools.description: Set a character's blocking in ONE shot — seated vs standing, on-screen visibility, over-the-shoulder framing, and left/right placement. The marquee per-shot directorial edit (e.g. 'seat him when he isn't speaking'). Use the shotCastId from get_shot_cast. Writes real data; needs a personal login.

mcpTools.name: update_shot
mcpTools.description: Change a shot's details — title, description, script/dialogue, and time-of-day (e.g. change a dusk shot to morning). Writes real data; needs a personal login.

mcpTools.name: update_line
mcpTools.description: Rewrite a character's dialogue in ONE shot (e.g. 'rewrite Sally's line here'). Use the shotCastId from get_shot_cast. Writes real data; needs a personal login.

mcpTools.name: get_character
mcpTools.description: Get one character (cast member) in a project — name, role, and image.

mcpTools.name: create_project
mcpTools.description: Create a new movie project in ACT3AI
